# Anna Nikiforova — React Frontend Developer

> Ottawa-based React Frontend Developer building responsive, accessible and polished web experiences with React, JavaScript, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. This site is a portfolio presenting projects, work experience, skills, education and contact information.

## Pages

- [Projects](https://annanikiforova.vercel.app/projects): Selected frontend projects with case studies, tech stacks, screenshots and live demos.
- [About](https://annanikiforova.vercel.app/#about): Professional summary, years of experience, certifications and core skills.
- [Experience](https://annanikiforova.vercel.app/#experience): Work history as a Frontend Developer.
- [Education](https://annanikiforova.vercel.app/#education): Education background and certifications.
- [Contact](https://annanikiforova.vercel.app/#contact): Get in touch by email, GitHub or LinkedIn.
- [Resume PDF](https://annanikiforova.vercel.app/anna-nikiforova-resume.pdf): Downloadable resume.

## Optional

- [Home](https://annanikiforova.vercel.app/): Portfolio homepage with the full single-page overview.
